title: The program does not work in "Full Screen" mode
body: When I set the "Full Screen" mode in CS2, the program stops displaying the menu and all the functions that are displayed on the screen. I need the "Full Screen" mode because I use resolutions for cs2 that are lower than the display
author: Diaron

comments.body: Before creating an issue, please read the instructions:  To play in fullscreen mode, right-click `cs2.exe`, go to **Properties → Compatibility**, and **uncheck** the *Disable fullscreen optimizations*.

title: Question about the project
body: Is there a chance you made this thing working with Titanfall 2? I really want keystrokes showcase option to have there.
author: Strykus

comments.body: Yes, it is possible if you remove all program checks and leave only the keystrokes.
Try setting an FPS limit for both the game and the ErScripts. For example, use `fps_max 60` or `fps_max 100` in CS2, and set the overlay FPS limit in the menu to 60.
